info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Payments Payments Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Payment Status Retrieval API allows clients to access the current status of payments processed through the system. This endpoint provides detailed insights regarding the state of various payment transactions, enabling users to track and manage their financial activities effectively. Typical consumers include financial institutions, e-commerce platforms, and any stakeholders monitoring payment operations. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance visibility into their payment workflows and resolve issues promptly.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current status of a payment. You can check if the payment is pending, completed, or failed, along with any relevant details.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of payments. This body should contain the necessary parameters to identify the payment status you wish to check.

206.description: Partial content successfully returned, processing details available.

ListPaymentsPaymentsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on payment status. It is expected to be a string value that captures some identifier or payload related to the payment status.

status.description: Indicates whether the payment operation is successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the transaction.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the payment operation.

state.description: Current state of the payment operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the payment operation in milliseconds.

message.description: Optional message providing additional information about the payment operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the payment operation.

ListPaymentsPaymentsStatusResponse_206.description: Schema representing the response for the status of a payment operation.

createdBy.description: Username or identifier of the user who created the payment operation.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the payment operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the payment operation was automated.

Audit.description: Schema representing the audit information for a payment operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, taken to process the request. This value can be used for performance monitoring and optimization.
